title: Resonant Geometry and Well-Posedness for the 2D Boussinesq Wave Kinetic Equation
summary: We study the wave kinetic equation (WKE) derived by Shavit--Bühler--Shatah from the two-dimensional Boussinesq system of internal waves. The equation is anisotropic and vector-valued, with a two-branch sign-changing dispersion relation, coupled propagation branches, and a sign-indefinite pseudo-momentum invariant. The resonant manifold has angular degeneracies that obstruct the standard analytic treatment of the collision operator.
